notes.title: Major Update! 03.12.2024
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW Levels![/h1]
[list]
[*]+10 absolutely new levels in Spooky World! Enjoy it!
[/list]

[h2]NEW TRACK[/h2]
[list]
[*]Awesome new music in Spooky World!
[/list]

[h2]Level changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]There are MORE Skulls, Magnets and Clocks in the Spooky World now!
[*]GLOBALLY reworked some levels in ALL worlds!
[/list]

[h2]Visual improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Shader-light system in all levels and menus!
[*]New style of Main Menu and Customize Menu!
[*]New decorative elements in level selection menus!
[*]New visual effects in menus and levels!
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed some minor bugs, just don't worry about it.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update! 07.15.2023
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW features![/h1]
[list]
[*]Now in Spooky World you can find [b]burning [u]Skulls[/u][/b] that do not bode well!
[*]Now [b]all Worlds[/b] are available for playing after completing tutorial, including Spooky World! However, to unlock Challanges, you still need to complete the 10th level of Spooky World.
[*]Now difficulty level of each World is visually indicated by skulls in world selection menu!
[/list]

[h2]New Localization![/h2]
[list]
[*]Bulgarian
[/list]

[h2]Level changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]There are MORE magnets in the Fire World now!
[*]GLOBALLY reworked some levels of Spooky and Fire worlds!
[*]Changed location of some platforms were players often falls when using portals.
[/list]

[h2]Visual improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New decorative elements in level selection menu!
[*]New visual effects in menus and levels!
[/list]

[h2]Controls Improvement:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Now instead of arrows you can use WASD! 
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now Game has an icon to display correctly on the taskbar. A trifle, but nice!
[*]Now the sound of picking up the magnet is clearly audible!
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where it was possible to pick up the same magnet several times if the effect of this magnet did not end
[/list]

notes.title: New Update! 17.06.2023
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW feature![/h1]
[list]
[*]Now in Fire World you can find [b]mysterious [u]Magnets[/u][/b] that attract gems from a great distance!
[*]Now you DO NOT NEED to go through [b]Ice World[/b] to be able to go through the [b]Fire World[/b]! However, to unlock Spooky World and Challanges, you still need to complete the 30th level of the Fire World.
[/list]

[h2]Visual improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New visual effects added! Glow, particles and more!
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed incorrect image of interface elements on some monitors.
[*]Fixed a bug with Cucumbinator Skin was not displayed as purchased.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which the music in the Spooky World would sometimes not stop in time.
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved camera behavior
[*]Changed the location of platforms on some levels
[/list]
